meta.name: firebase-auth-basics
meta.description: Guide for setting up and using Firebase Authentication. Use this skill when the user's app requires user sign-in, user management, or secure data access using auth rules.

copy.tagline_en: Add sign-in and user access control to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building an app that needs user accounts and login.

howto.what: Claude 按步骤讲解 Firebase 登录配置:启用邮箱密码、Google、匿名等登录方式,接入 Web/Flutter/Android 客户端,并用 request.auth 编写安全规则。
howto.when: 当你的应用需要用户登录、用户管理,或通过认证规则保护数据访问时触发;例如要求配置 Firebase Auth 或某个登录方式。

say.text: 帮我在 Firebase 里开启 Google 登录
我的 Web 应用怎么接入邮箱密码登录?
say.note: Claude 会引用 Web 客户端接入指南并说明要点。

say.text: 怎么用 request.auth 保护 Firestore 数据?

howto.what_en: Claude guides Firebase Auth setup: explains users, providers, tokens; enables email/password, Google, anonymous via CLI or console; covers Web/Flutter/Android client setup and security rules using request.auth.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the app needs user sign-in, user management, or auth-rule-protected data access, e.g., when you ask to configure Firebase Auth or a specific sign-in method.

say_en.text: Help me enable Google Sign-In in Firebase.
say_en.note: Claude will provide CLI or console steps and remind you to deploy auth config.

say_en.text: How do I add email/password login to my web app?
say_en.note: Claude will point to the web client setup guide and explain key points.

say_en.text: How do I protect Firestore data with request.auth?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the syntax for security rules.
